NETWORK
When two or more computers are
interconnected to exchange information
with each other, it is called a network.
Data
transmission
and
Communication : The exchange of
information and data from one system
to another computer system is known
as data communication.
Transmission media: Transmission
media generally divided into two
categories:
1. Wired media
2. Wireless media
1. Wired media: In this type of media
cable is used for transmission of
signals from one computer to other
computers.
Wired media transmission:
I. Twisted pair cable: There are two
insulated copper wires, which are
twisted each other spirally or as like
coal.
The main purpose of twisting is to
minimize the electrical interference.
In this type of media electrical
interference goes very low due to
opposite electric interference in
these twisted wires. This type of
interference is called as cross talk.
Types twisted pair
1. Unshielded Twisted Pair Cable
(UTP): It is used in computer and
telecommunication mediums.
Its frequency range is very suitable
for transmitting both data and voice
